notes.title: DOORKA DEMO v.1.1 version release
notes.content:
BUGFIXES
Fixed levels not loading (black screen) for some devices.
Please report through Feedback window (F8) if you still get this problem!

Level ranks now save correctly.

Fix doors stuck in some areas. 

Fix persistence of tutorial messages between levels.

Fix enemy navigation in level "Door storage".
VISUALS
Updated some textures.

Changed lighting settings for better visibility.



Thanks for playing DOORKA!
